card.name: Start of the brand name SYMTUZA
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand name split into parts, mainly SY at the start of SYMTUZA (also SYMBRAVO) after words like 'of', 'with' or 'to' in interaction text. Also fires on a few other word-initial pieces in names.

modes.label: SYMTUZA start
modes.description: The SY piece that begins SYMTUZA after 'with', 'of' or 'to' in drug interaction passages.

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: Rare names or words broken into pieces, where the marked piece begins or sits early in the word.

card.writes: It promotes 'ful'-type words (fulfill, fulfillment), which has little to do with the brand name, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of the brand name SYMTUZA when it is split into pieces.
